title: Precision
description: Compact controls, fine dividers and restrained type for working tools.
tradeoff: Compact controls need careful touch spacing.

title: Editorial
description: Serif headlines, generous reading space and quiet controls.
tradeoff: Serif headings are less suited to dense numeric controls.

title: Marketplace
description: Roomy controls, open cards and welcoming rounded shapes.
tradeoff: Roomy controls show fewer records at once.

title: Tactile
description: Inset edges, layered shadows and controls with physical depth.
tradeoff: Shadows need consistent surface contrast. Optional audio may be unavailable.

title: Industrial
description: Square geometry, strong rules and geometric typography.
tradeoff: Keep decorative Doto type in titles, with the existing body fonts for reading.

title: Glass
description: Translucent layers, soft edges and luminous surface depth.
tradeoff: Contrast depends on the backdrop; blur adds rendering cost.

title: Neutral
description: Quiet surfaces, balanced spacing and unobtrusive controls.
tradeoff: Quiet surfaces provide less visual emphasis by default.

title: Expressive
description: Emphatic controls, layered surfaces and a stronger visual rhythm.
tradeoff: Keep status colors distinct from the primary action color.
